RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the March 14, 2008/Phalguna 24, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel )
Total number of questions — 20
68
Import of urea
*221. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHA TTERJEE:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of urea imported during
2004-05, 2005-06 and 2006-07;
(b) the estimated import during
2007-08;
(c) the cost of imported urea per tonne
during the above years;
(d) the present cost of the imported
urea; and
(e) the steps taken to reduce its import?
Coordination between States and
Central Government on agriculture
†*222. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) how his Ministry co-ordinates with
the Departments of Agriculture of the
States;
(b)  whether recently any conference of
the Ministers of Agriculture of the States
was convened in Delhi;
(c) the amount that would have been
incurred on the genuine welfare of farmers
in the country, so far;
(d) whether any conflict has arisen
between the Central Government and the
State Governments on the agriculture
budget so far; and
(e) whether Government is
contemplating to prepare ‘Agriculture
Budget’ on the lines of ‘Railway Budget’?
Review of policy of permitting big
retail corporates
*223. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has lately
reviewed its policy on permitting big retail
corporates to expand their footprints in
retail markets, so as not to hurt local
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

69
groceries, including vendors of vegetables
and fruits;
(b) if so, the decisions taken in the matter
to protect the interests of small retailers
and consumers; and
(c) the steps taken and the directions
issued by Government in this regard?
Posts abolished in Railways
*224. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of regular employees vis-
a-vis contractors' workers in Railways
during the period 2001-02 to 2005-06,
category-wise and year-wise; and
(b) the number of posts abolished in
Railways during the corresponding period?
Rail accidents in the country
*225. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of rail accidents
reported across the country during the last
year;
(b) the total loss of life and property
due to these accidents;
(c) the compensation paid to the
affected families of the deceased in these
accidents;
(d) whether it is a fact that many cases
of compensation are still pending in the
Ministry and if so, how they are likely to
be disposed of;
(e) what are the reasons for these
tragedies reported;
(f) how many persons in the Ministry
found negligent in duties have been brought
to book; and
(g) what steps are being taken to prevent
such accidents in future?
Rise in the sale prices of steel
†*226. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the consumer
sale price of steel has been on continuous
rise in the country during the past years;
(b) if so, the average prices of different
varieties of steel in the country during April,
2004 and at the end of December, 2007;
and
(c) to what extent the prices of all
material used in steel manufacturing have
increased during the said period?
Demand and supply of steel
commodity
*227. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
fact that the demand for the steel
commodity is growing whereas the supply
is less;
(b) whether Government has taken any
steps to bridge the gap between demand
and supply of this commodity;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

70
Sale of gender identification kits
*228. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that gender
identification kits are available for sale by a
US based company through a website; and
(b) if so, the steps Government is
contemplating either to ban the website in
the country or regulate its sale in the
country?
Disabilities due to alcohol
consumption
*229. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
consumption of alcohol is ruining the health
of millions of young people in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether alcoholism is creating host
of diseases and disabilities in people;
